propositions: caused_by links accept any target without validating that the target has a referencing commit in the code repository
caused_by is the only machine-readable causation edge and current misattributions (most-linked targets with unrelated children) undermine metrics and close reasons
the referencing-commit scan exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits and is not reused by link validation, allowing preview (--dry-run) to drift from refusal behavior
a commit-less target must be refused for caused_by unless explicitly forced with --force, with the same enforcement across CLI, library, and MCP interfaces

the refusal must apply only to the resolved target itself (not descendants) because caused_by names the specific introducing change, and crediting an epic through children is the exact misattribution to prevent
unverifiable targets (no code repo, no git history) must be allowed; refusal means only 'target has no commit', never 'this clone has no history'
